title: The Mysterious Mandalorian of Tatooine
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: The Mandalorian knows that Grogu should be returned to those of his kind, but does not have any inclination how to locate other Mandalorians or Jedi for help. After hearing whispers of a Mandalorian haunting the desert climes of Tatooine, Mando and Grogu encounter Cobb Vanth, the Marshal of Mos Pelgo, whose armor immediately piques Mando's curiosity.
